summary: APOGEE: Lunar Mission is a browser-based aerospace engineering and financial survival simulator built by Team Peace. Using real-world rocket physics and NASA lunar mission parameters, players design multi-stage rockets and manage a space agency's budget to reach the Moon without going bankrupt.
details:
APOGEE: Lunar Mission is an interactive, browser-based aerospace engineering and financial survival simulator built by Team Peace. Running a space agency takes more than just building big rockets—it requires smart engineering and tight financial discipline. Our game puts players in the seat of a flight director and agency manager through a 6-milestone campaign from suborbital flights to lunar missions.

How It Works & Key Features:

- Multi-Stage Vehicle Workshop: Players customize Stage 1 boosters and Stage 2 upper stages, adjusting propellant loads, engine specs, booster recovery kits, and launch insurance while monitoring real-time telemetry like Thrust-to-Weight Ratio (TWR) and total Delta-V.

- R&D & Tech Progression: Players earn Science Points from flights to unlock advanced cryogenic engines, carbon-nano composites, and passive patent income.

- Financial Survival & Crisis Management: Every month brings operating expenses (OpEx). Players fulfill commercial contracts, manage credit lines, or navigate emergency bailouts and debt restructuring if funds run low.

- Flight Archives & Failure Logs: Every launch records full telemetry and black-box science data, helping players learn from anomalies and improve future blueprints.

Intended Impact & Design Considerations:

Our goal is to make complex orbital mechanics and space mission planning accessible, engaging, and educational for students and space enthusiasts. We designed the game as a zero-install web application with bilingual support (English and Traditional Chinese) and auto-save functionality so anyone can play immediately on any browser.

Tools, Coding Languages & Open-Source Code:

- Languages & Tools: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, LocalStorage API, GitHub Pages, and CapCut for video editing.

- Open-Source Repository: https://github.com/ant-design21/apogee-lunar-mission
